items.summary: Local officials warn some services remain unavailable even as Outlook starts to resume normal operations after outageMicrosoft outage – live updatesThe Microsoft Outlook outage has shaken up companies and local governments across the US that use its suite of email, calendar, video conferencing and cloud storage systems.Even as Outlook started to resume normal operations Friday morning, local leaders from across the country, including in Miami, Maryland and Los Angeles, warned residents that certain staff or services were still unavailable due to the outage that started around 1pm ET on Thursday. items.title: USA hammer Denmark 14-0 with record 85 shots to reach women’s hockey worlds semi-finals
items.summary: Americans set tournament record with 85 shots on goalHarvey and Winn score twice each in 14-0 routCanada edge Czechs 3-2 to set up Sweden semi-finalDefending champions the United States marched into the semi-finals of the women’s ice hockey world championship with a crushing 14-0 victory over hosts Denmark on Friday.The Americans stormed out of the blocks, racing into a 5-0 lead inside eight minutes before stretching their advantage to 10-0 by the end of the second period in the first-ever meeting between the teams.
